verdict.rationale: Factory offers several features that generate AI-driven insights/suggestions from a user's own data: the /readiness-report and /readiness-fix commands analyze a repository and surface actionable suggestions, and Software Factory provides an 'automation coverage map' view of the delivery lifecycle. These are concrete AI-generated insights inside the product, but they're scoped to repo/dev-lifecycle data rather than a broad analytics/insights dashboard over arbitrary user data. Missing for 10: evidence of general-purpose data analytics/insight generation beyond repo readiness and delivery coverage, and independent/hands-on validation of insight quality.
